falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 low equivalent (adjusted for pattern similarity) would invalidate the bottom_2024_aug pattern match, as that bottom held with no lower lows; this would confirm continuation lower not a bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom saw VIX peak near 28-30 and rapidly compress; sustained elevated fear above 35 would indicate this is not a similar bottoming structure but rather an accelerating sell-off/bear market phase

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops more than 40 basis points from current level within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom occurred with yields stable-to-rising; a sharp flight-to-quality bid in bonds would signal recession/deleveraging panic rather than the soft-landing bottom pattern currently matched

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
